vestafolio-micro-entreprise v1.2.1

- Now uses actual Vestafolio API calls to compare micro-entreprise, régime réel, and versement libératoire, rather than relying on remembered tax rules.
- Collects all necessary simulator inputs before recommending a regime or giving any quantitative answer, always asking missing questions in French.
- Provides clear workflow and handling for incomplete, conflicting, or unclear user inputs, aligned with the Vestafolio workflow.
- Supports consulting and freelance micro-entreprise regime choices, including ACRE and versement libératoire eligibility.
- Will not substitute mental arithmetic, schema defaults, or generic advice—replies are grounded in simulator/API results.
- Links back to the Vestafolio interactive simulator when unable to complete the calculation.
